With the shipped prompt, Qwen2.5-3B Q4_K_M + n_ubatch 256 gave first-word p95 1466.6, 1466.0 and 1526.0 ms in three runs (target 1500); over all seven 3B runs (any layout) 1375-1542 ms, 3 missed.
